---
title: "Citation"
---

The DenMark manuscript is under review at *Cell Reports Methods*. If you use DenMark in your research, please cite the preprint:

> Xu M, Schmidt AM, Zhang Q. DenMark: A Bayesian Hierarchical Model for Identifying Cell-Density Correlated Genes from Spatial Transcriptomics. *bioRxiv*, 2026. doi: [10.64898/2026.04.02.713482](https://doi.org/10.64898/2026.04.02.713482)

GitHub's "Cite this repository" button uses the [`CITATION.cff`](https://github.com/StaGill/DenMark/blob/main/CITATION.cff) file in the repository. In R, `citation()` gives the reference for the paper and for the installed version of the package:

```{r}
citation("DenMark")
```

## BibTeX

```bibtex
@article{xu2026denmark,
  title   = {{DenMark}: A Bayesian Hierarchical Model for Identifying Cell-Density Correlated Genes from Spatial Transcriptomics},
  author  = {Xu, Mingchi and Schmidt, Alexandra M. and Zhang, Qihuang},
  journal = {bioRxiv},
  year    = {2026},
  doi     = {10.64898/2026.04.02.713482},
  note    = {Preprint; the revised manuscript is under review at Cell Reports Methods}
}
```
